plan_review.notes: The separate-model review found that creation retries alone cannot repair existing unassigned nodes; replaced that design with a scoped post-creation and hourly trusted intake reprocessor.

code_review.notes: Reviewed all five changed files. The marker/author concern is covered by intakeOpenedIssue trusted-opener validation; repeated intake is intentionally idempotent and preserves existing kickoff comments.

independent_grade.notes: The implementation cleanly resolves the epic-node activation gap caused by GitHub suppressing issues.opened events for GITHUB_TOKEN mutations. It adds a dedicated Epic Reprocess script and workflow that runs post-creation and hourly, correctly filtering for open managed epic nodes and respecting textual blocker dependencies before assigning Copilot via the trusted intake library. The diff includes thorough unit tests for the reprocessor logic and workflow YAML configs, updates documentation, adheres to repo policies, and maintains clean scope discipline with no unrelated changes.
